name: Villamantilla (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villamantilla (a bridge on red and a fleur-de-lis on blue).
history: Villamantilla adopted its arms and flag officially on 9 January 1996, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 18 February 1997; the flag is of proportions 2:3, a cloth white in the upper half and blue in the lower, with the municipal arms over all at the centre.

features.role: Villamantilla arms — bridge on red and fleur-de-lis on blue
